---
title: "2026 Florida Republican Primary for Governor"
format: html
execute:
  echo: true
  message: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)

# Read all 67 county tab-separated files (which have no header row)
files <- list.files("data", pattern = "\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)

gov_rep <- read_tsv(
  files,
  col_names = FALSE,
  quote = "",
  col_select = c(office = X12, candidate = X15, party = X16, votes = X19),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  # Keep only Republican candidates in the Governor primary
  filter(office == "Governor", party == "REP") |>
  # Sum total votes across all precincts and counties for each candidate
  summarize(total_votes = sum(as.numeric(votes), na.rm = TRUE), .by = candidate)

# Plot candidate vote totals ordered from highest to lowest
ggplot(gov_rep, aes(x = total_votes, y = fct_reorder(candidate, total_votes))) +
  geom_col(fill = "firebrick") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +
  labs(
    title = "2026 Florida Republican Primary for Governor",
    subtitle = "Official precinct-level vote totals across all 67 counties",
    x = "Total Votes",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Source: Florida Department of State"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
